text: The purpose of this report is to advise Toronto City Council, pursuant to Chapter 195 of the Toronto Municipal Code, Procurement, Section 195-7.5.B, of a non-competitive contract with Webber Infrastructure Management Canada Limited for emergency snow removal services, for a total value of $942,425 net of all taxes and charges ($959,012 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries). The issuance of this non-competitive contract was a matter of extreme urgency to expedite snow removal and cleanup following the January 25-26, 2026 major snowstorm, which produced approximately 60 centimetres of snow. This, combined with the major snowstorm of January 14-15, 2026, brought the total snowfall for January to approximately 90 centimetres city-wide.
